messages:
matt (CustSuccess): Heads-up: Helios Bio says their latest invoice jumped ~25% on platform fees after they migrated a staging cluster to Dedicated last month. Customer says billing metric changed; wants credit. Can we triage?

omar (AE): On it — I pinged their billing contact, Priya. She sent the invoice and a note: 'we expected platform fees on committed GPU-hours, not per-node-hour usage.'

sasha (Solutions): Quick note: the migration changed their pool type from 'gpu-reserved' to 'auto-node' (lower-level orchestration). That flips the metering key from reserved_gpu_hours -> node_compute_hours. It'll inflate platform fee unless mapping applied.

billing-bot: Invoice 987654 created for Helios Bio (acct HLS-321). Total: $132,400. Platform fee line: $24,850.

elaine (Finance): Need hard numbers. Can someone paste the invoice line items and the mapping change logs? We need to propose a provisional credit while we investigate.

omar (AE): Priya uploaded the invoice PDF and included this summary:

```
Invoice 987654
- Reserved GPU commit (monthly): $65,000
- Usage overage (compute node-hours): $18,300
- Platform fee (2.2% on usage lines): $24,850
- Support (enterprise, S1): $8,250
Total: $132,400
```

She says: 'We never agreed to node-hours; contract shows platform fee applies to committed capacity.'

sasha (Solutions): I pulled our telemetry. Post-migration (2024-11-03) the metric emitted was node_compute_hours and our billing ETL picked that up. Query snippet I ran:

```
SELECT sum(node_hours) as node_hours
FROM metering.events
WHERE account = 'HLS-321' AND ts >= '2024-11-01' AND ts <= '2024-11-30';
-- result: 12,230 node_hours
```

If we reapply a committed_gpu_hours conversion (their commit is 4x A100 equiv), effective billed usage would be ~7,800 gpu_hours -> platform fee drops ~40%.

elaine (Finance): Thanks. Two asks: 1) propose a provisional credit number for customer-facing comms; 2) confirm root cause and long-term fix so we don't repeat.

zoe (Legal): I'll pull their MSA. Quick read: clause 3.1 defines 'Committed Capacity' as GPU-hours. It doesn't mention node-hours explicitly. We should be conservative with credits until clause confirmed.

elaine (Finance): Proposal: issue provisional credit equal to the platform fee delta between node-hour calc and committed-gpu-hour calc for Nov 2024. Sasha, can you compute delta estimate? If under $25k we can approve without exec sign-off; above needs manager OK.

sasha (Solutions): Running the conversion now. Estimating platform fee delta ≈ $10,950 (node-based -> gpu-committed calc). Give me 20 min.

billing-bot: Credit request created: CR-2024-559 (pending approval). Amount: TBD.

omar (AE): Priya wants a timely response; she flagged potential churn risk. I suggested we acknowledge and provide a timeline for resolution.

(20 minutes later)

sasha (Solutions): Final calc attached below.

```
Nov node-based platform fee = $24,850
Nov committed-gpu equivalent platform fee = $13,900
Delta = $10,950
```

This uses commit factor 4x and internal sku conversion table. Details in internal doc: /internal/billing/mapping/committed-to-node.md (shared to finance).

elaine (Finance): Good. I'll approve provisional credit for $10,950 to be applied to invoice 987654 as 'platform fee reconciliation credit' pending legal review and final reconciliation. Document terms: provisional credit will be reversed if final audit finds mapping was correct.

zoe (Legal): I confirm clause language supports applying credit while we investigate. I'll send a short addendum to Priya confirming provisional nature.

omar (AE): Noted. I'll communicate to Priya and ask for any logs showing intended billing metric from their infra/CS ops.

sasha (Solutions): Action: add fallback mapping to the billing ETL so node->gpu conversion is applied when account has active GPU commit flag. I'll open a bug/PR and include test vectors.

elaine (Finance): Final asks before I ticket the credit: (A) attach the invoice PDF from Priya; (B) confirm final credit amount $10,950; (C) include CR-2024-559 as reference on the credit memo.

omar (AE): Uploaded invoice.pdf to thread. Confirming customer accepts provisional credit while they pull their logs.

matt (CustSuccess): Nice. Please mark this as high priority — risk flag set on account until reconciliation complete.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2024-112 issued for $10,950 against Invoice 987654. Status: PROVISIONAL.

elaine (Finance): I'll route for accounting entries and ensure the CM has the provisional tag. Once we finalize after legal and the mapping audit, we'll either keep or reverse the credit. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:

omar (AE): I'll update the customer and set expectation for 5 business days.

matt (CustSuccess): Closing loop here after reconciliation.

zoe (Legal): Adding note to contract file: Helios_Bio_MSA_v3 — provisional credit logged.

sasha (Solutions): Follow-ups: PR link to come, and I'll add telemetry alert to detect metric-key flips for committed accounts.

elaine (Finance): Done — closing for now. Will reopen if audit changes numbers.
